entries.wording: Shipment Information sent to the Carrier
entries.note: The parcel's data sent to the carrier that will move it, at the sender's warehouse, before anyone takes the parcel.
The carrier's terminal takes the parcel in, the first scan with the parcel in hand; it comes with the pickup scan, at the same second.

entries.wording: Arrived at the final destination WP distribution center
entries.note: Western Post's own distribution center that delivers the parcel.
